# Pierre-Antoine Roy

> Pierre-Antoine Roy creates content at AppTweak (since March 2026): data-driven articles and posts on App Store Optimization (ASO), app marketing and mobile growth. After hours, he makes games; his first one, Spiller!, is out on iPhone. Background in product design, growth and content marketing. Speaks French, English and Spanish. Based in Brussels, Belgium.

## About

- [Home page and resume](https://pierreantoineroy.com/): current work, experience since 2022, skills, tools and references
- Contact: hello@pierreantoineroy.com

## Now

- [AppTweak](https://www.apptweak.com): content on ASO, app marketing and mobile growth, from the blog to LinkedIn, newsletters and video
- [Spiller!](https://pierreantoineroy.com/spiller/) ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6828435267)): a one-tap mobile game (hold to pour, release right on the line), designed and built in Unity. Android coming soon. Instagram: [@spiller_game](https://www.instagram.com/spiller_game/)

- Bachelor of Foreign Applied Languages, Université de Tours; Notion Essentials, Workflows and Advanced certifications
